memory_candidates.content: The Neovim extension loader's Lua API (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/init.lua) does NOT expose a module-level `M.manager` table for headless verification. The correct invocation shape is: `require('...extensions.config').claude()` (or `.opencode()`) to build a config, then `require('...extensions.init').create(config)` to get a manager instance, then `manager.load(name, {project_dir=..., confirm=false})`. A naive `require('...extensions.init').manager.load(...)` fails with 'attempt to index field manager (a nil value)'.

check-extension-docs.sh's Rule R cross-checks each context markdown file's actual line count against a `line_count` field recorded in that extension's index-entries.json. Any edit that changes a documented context file's length (even by a few lines) trips a new FAIL until the corresponding index-entries.json entry is updated. Prefer a targeted single-entry Edit over the global `generate-context-line-counts.sh --write` when only one extension's entry needs correction, since --write rewrites every stale entry across every extension, including unrelated pre-existing drift from concurrent sessions.
